items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:76:1
items.html: The first Behina, how the Olamot were when Adam ha Rishon was created. We must know that this first Behina is considered the “constant” of Mochin de BYA, but they descended from their place because of the sin of Etz ha Daat.
